tasks.label: cache-consistency
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$h=@{'Content-Type'='application/json'}; $r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/auth/login' -Method Post -Headers $h -Body '{\"email\":\"newuser@qq.com\",\"password\":\"123456\",\"role\":2}'; $t=$r.data.token; $auth=@{'Content-Type'='application/json';'Authorization'='Bearer '+$t}; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/cart' -Method Post -Headers $auth -Body '{\"goodId\":39,\"amount\":1}' | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/goods/39' -Headers $auth -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; $d1 = docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 exists cache:goods:detail:39 2>$null; Write-Output ('DETAIL-CACHE-BEFORE=' + $d1); Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/order/pay' -Method Post -Headers $auth -Body '{\"goodIds\":[39]}' | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $d2 = docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 exists cache:goods:detail:39 2>$null; $l = docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 keys 'cache:goods:list:*' 2>$null; Write-Output ('DETAIL-CACHE-AFTER=' + $d2); Write-Output ('LIST-CACHE-AFTER=' + $l)"

tasks.label: vo-cache-check
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$h=@{'Content-Type'='application/json'}; $r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/auth/login' -Method Post -Headers $h -Body '{\"email\":\"newuser@qq.com\",\"password\":\"123456\",\"role\":2}'; $t=$r.data.token; $auth=@{'Content-Type'='application/json';'Authorization'='Bearer '+$t}; $o=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/order' -Headers $auth; Write-Output ('ORDER-VO=' + ($o.data.records[0] | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/goods?page=1&size=5' -Headers $auth -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; $v = docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 get 'cache:goods:list:||||score|desc|1|5' 2>$null; Write-Output ('LIST-CACHE-PREFIX=' + $v.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(60, $v.Length)))"

tasks.label: breakdown-regression
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8081/api/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{\"email\":\"newuser@qq.com\",\"password\":\"123456\",\"role\":2}'; $t = $r.data.token; docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 del cache:goods:detail:40 2>$null | Out-Null; 1..10 | ForEach-Object { Start-Job -ScriptBlock { param($tk) curl.exe -sS -o NUL -H ('Authorization: Bearer ' + $tk) http://localhost:8081/api/goods/40 } -ArgumentList $t } | Out-Null; Get-Job | Wait-Job | Out-Null; Get-Job | Remove-Job; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $log = Get-Content 'D:\DownLoad\chesnake-deploy\backend.log' -Raw; $n = ([regex]::Matches($log, 'Parameters: 40')).Count; Write-Output ('CONCURRENT-10-DB-QUERIES=' + $n); $lock = docker exec chesnake-redis redis-cli -a chesnake123 keys 'lock:goods:*' 2>$null; Write-Output ('LOCK-REMAINED=' + $lock)"
